summary: Your feelings and your temper are wired close together: you feel fast and react faster. Warmth and heat live in the same place, so closeness can tip into friction before you see it coming.
body: Your feelings and your temper are wired close together: you feel fast and react faster. Warmth and heat live in the same place, so closeness can tip into friction before you see it coming. This can trace back to a home where anger and love got tangled, or where you had to fight to be heard. You may flare and regret it, or swallow it, then turn on whoever is closest. The work is letting the feeling move through your body before it comes out of your mouth.
gift: At your best: passionate, honest, quick to defend the people you love.
shadow: The trap: snapping at the ones closest to you, then sitting in the regret.
integration: Treat anger as a messenger, not the whole message. Your needs deserve action, but they also deserve accuracy.
do: Move the feeling physically before you speak
Let the heat protect, not punish
dont: Fire off the text while it's hot
Punish people for your own activation
